questions.question: PhD group's PRIMARY daily use case?
questions.insight: Quick Actions pipeline is critical path. PARA classification matters. Inbox processing workflow.

questions.question: Timeline pressure for Beta?
questions.insight: Quality over speed. Research-grade reliability. No artificial deadline.

questions.question: What does 'flawlessly' mean?
questions.insight: Highest bar: animations smooth, feedback instant, results actionable. Premium feel required.

questions.question: Vault size for testing?
questions.insight: WASM migration is P0 blocker. SimpleVectorStore won't scale. Archie working on this.

synthesis: Beta quality bar is HIGH: Delightful UX at scale. Primary use case is Knowledge Triage (inbox processing, classification). Timeline is quality-driven, not deadline-driven. Scale target is 10K-100K notes, confirming WASM migration as P0 blocker.
keyDecisions: Quick Actions pipeline is critical path for PhD testers
WASM vector store is P0 (currently in progress via CODE RED)
Delightful UX = animations, instant feedback, actionable results
No artificial timeline - ship when quality is right
